- [ ] New behaviour is covered by tests; fixed bugs have a regression test
- [ ] User-facing strings are translated (`en` and `pt-PT`)
- [ ] No hardcoded colours or spacing — design tokens only
- [ ] Clinical data changes cite their standard and explain the correction
